title: Conjecture 3.4 — Strong Four Exponentials Conjecture
exact_target: Can both pairs of directions, each linearly independent over the algebraic numbers, have all four products in the algebraic span of one and logarithms of algebraic numbers?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8700022 (AMR-086-0022). CC BY 4.0.
